CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

2. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   B. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.

3. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

4. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

   D. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.

5. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)

   D. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.

7. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. Only the costume
   C. Only the volume
   D. The ticket price

8. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   D. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. Best practice when working on Storytelling and Animation: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Storytelling and Animation.
   B. Practise Storytelling and Animation with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Storytelling and Animation.
   D. Damage equipment used for Storytelling and Animation.

10. Best practice when working on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Damage equipment used for Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.

11. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)

12. Best practice when working on Handball: (1 mark)

   C. Damage equipment used for Handball.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Handball.

13. Best practice when working on Javelin and Sculpture: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Javelin and Sculpture.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Javelin and Sculpture.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Javelin and Sculpture.
   D. Practise Javelin and Sculpture with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

14. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Replace drinking water

15. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   B. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Games.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Javelin and Sculpture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
